title: Park Freeze Tag
game_overview: Auto-sprint through a fenced park using only Left and Right Shift keys to steer your freeze aura into five kids in 20 seconds.
winning_condition: Freeze all 5 fleeing kids with your frost tag within the 20-second time limit.
losing_condition: The 20-second timer hits zero with one or more kids still running free.

controls.action: Steer tagger left while auto-sprinting forward.
Steer tagger right while auto-sprinting forward.

sections.title: Controls & Locomotion
sections.content: The tagger continuously moves forward automatically. Locomotion is strictly controlled by Left Shift (steer left) and Right Shift (steer right). Tagging occurs passively via a 4.2-meter glowing Freeze Aura radius encircling the tagger.
